content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.information: Online, through the R&D Cell recruitment portal

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is an institute located in Guwahati, Assam. This notice comes from its Research and Development Section. The post is in the project "Development of functional recombinant humanized monoclonal antibody, Tocilizumab production from microbial cell factories" at the Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Project Research Scientist 1 Vacancy Details 2026
IIT Guwahati Project Research Scientist 1 Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Mandatory qualification: First-class PG degree, including integrated PG degree, or Second class postgraduate degree, including the integrated PG degree, with Ph.D. Preferred: Candidates with hands-on experience in the following areas will be preferred: Recombinant DNA Technology Bioprocess Engineering Metabolic Engineering Mammalian cell culture-related work See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the candidate's performance in the interview. The interview will be held online on Microsoft Teams, and the link will be shared with shortlisted candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email, and call letters will not be sent separately.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a project post, with the appointment made for 04 months. The period may be extended. The place of work is the Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering, IIT Guwahati. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Project Research Scientist 1 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati . Find the position by searching for the project title: "Development of functional recombinant humanized monoclonal antibody, Tocilizumab production from microbial cell factories". Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal, and complete the online application by 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Which project is this post for?
faq.answer: The post is in the project "Development of functional recombinant humanized monoclonal antibody, Tocilizumab production from microbial cell factories".

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply with a second class postgraduate degree?
faq.answer: Yes, but a second class postgraduate degree, including an integrated PG degree, must be held with a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q3. Which experience gets preference?
faq.answer: Hands-on experience in Recombinant DNA Technology, Bioprocess Engineering, Metabolic Engineering and Mammalian cell culture-related work will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. How do I find this position on the portal?
faq.answer: Search for the project title given in the advertisement on the Research & Development Cell's recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q5. Do I need to travel to Guwahati for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The interview is online on Microsoft Teams at 3 PM on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Will I receive a call letter?
faq.answer: No. Call letters will not be sent separately, and shortlisted candidates will be informed through email.

faq.question: Q7. Will the institute provide accommodation?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Whom should I contact with questions about the post?
faq.answer: Contact the Principal Investigator, Professor Venkata Dasu Veeranki, at [email protected] or on 03612582212/2244.
